engineVersionBasis: jmap dumper and UAssetAPI parser use the UE 5.8 serialization contract; the separate ElectrifiedBoat generator is pinned to Unreal Editor 5.8.2
generator: ihsoft/jmap Voyage UE 5.8 compatibility fork; canonical published binary
generationWorkflow: tools/New-VoyageMappings.ps1 live-process USMAP generation with jmap --all and JMAP_CONCURRENCY=128

validation.mappingGate: Test-VoyageMappings.ps1 passed header, payload, fingerprint, hash and required-name checks
validation.assetParser: Get-VoyageAssetSummary.ps1 or Get-VoyageAssetJson.ps1 parsed current stock BP_WallSocket_Electric, BP_AttachmentVirtualSocketActor_Electricity, and TestBoat with this mapping; no pseudocode failures
validation.runtime: Read-only live reflection capture and offline parser validation only; no gameplay compatibility claim
